spec.name: Furniture Floor Lamp
spec.description: A tall brass floor lamp with a stepped weighted base, slender stem, and open cream fabric shade. Warm woven panels and restrained brass patina give this connected, twelve-cuboid piece a cozy survival furniture silhouette. Front faces negative Z; dimensions are in Minecraft model units.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: tall brass floor lamp with cream square fabric shade. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..32, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
